verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS platform with a documented REST API, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask. However, no evidence shows one is published: every probed candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. The API docs, llms.txt and MCP server are separate capabilities and do not stand in for a machine-readable spec.
